scientific_integrity: The theorem is established by an explicit 3-adic proof and limited finite consistency checks. The manuscript compares to preprint versions of directly relevant papers; possible journal revisions or corrections are an unresolved bibliographic risk.
scientific_limitations: Only prime three, diagonal homogeneous cubics with at least two nonzero integer coefficients.
Exact quotient surjectivity is shown for Z_3 inputs; integer inputs yield density, not exact surjectivity.
Bibliographic priority is not independently certified; final journal versions and errata require separate comparison.
title: Universal 3-adic density for diagonal binary cubic quotient sets
